admission: Convenience byte-composition of four existing root-adopted ordinary-text streams only. No new action or document admission and no change to native, recurrence, source-world, or active-training counts.
notes: Ready ordinary-text foundation input: 4,880 byte-preserved documents (3,176 train / 1,704 test) validated through the shared frozen load_text_rows loader. The input file is a canonical run-path symlink to its immutable data on /srv/storage. Root composition and loader receipts are included; the renderer package and tokenizer are pinned by reuse map to exact bytes in the already-registered parent snapshot rather than duplicated.
